Référence 5874888
|
Créé le 17 juin 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Data-driven mindset? This is your opportunity to grow from junior to expert, supported by a company committed to your learning and development.
If you already have your first professional experience and are looking
to deepen your expertise and grow further
, this international company is ready to support your development.
In return? They are looking for motivation, passion, and a strong eagerness to learn. Join a small, dynamic team in Brussels and contribute to the
development of innovative data solutions
.
Data Analyst - Role & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain
data-driven solutions
, business applications, and automated workflows to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
Design and implement
Python-based tools, scripts, and reporting solutions
for data processing and process automation.
Analyze business needs and manual processes, translating them into sustainable digital workflows and innovative solutions.
Integrate applications and data sources within the Microsoft ecosystem through
APIs
and automation platforms.
Lead and support automation projects, ensuring proper documentation, testing, governance, security, and continuous improvement of existing solutions.
Profil
Data Analyst - Profile
Bachelor's degree in
Computer Science
, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum
2 years of experience
in data analysis, automation, or business application development (motivated junior candidates are also encouraged to apply).
Strong knowledge of
Python, SQL, Linux
, and Microsoft Power Platform (
Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse
).
Analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and the ability to translate complex information into practical business solutions.
Strong communication skills, team spirit, and fluency in
English and Dutch
;
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
Data Analyst - Offer & Benefits
A dynamic role with a high level of variety, involving collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
The opportunity to work on impactful projects focused on
automation, optimization, and digital transformation
.
A collaborative environment where innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued.
Professional growth opportunities through exposure to modern technologies, cross-functional projects, and international teams.
Benefits
Meal Vouchers
Fuel Card
Internal & External trainings
Company phone & subscription
Net Expenses
End-of-year bonuses
Group Insurance
Health Insurance
Cafetaria Plan
Team-building & incentives
4 days remote
Flexible holidays
32 days off
Flexible working hours
